scenarios.command: python3 delivery_toolchain/release/check_release_phase.py --environment dev --release-sha c2ed5e426dbad54ff3f64f7cb36adfaa50e46bc8 --task-id ODP-RELEASE-BUILD-PHASE-BOOTSTRAP-001 --phase build --lease-supplied true --oidc-configured true --receipt <receipt>
